Use case: stylized-concept. Render as bold genuine 2D 16-bit PIXEL ART game mockup. Large, clearly square hand-clustered pixels, sharp stair-step contours, no smooth bevels or blur, very limited shades per creature. Moody plum-black background with thin muted purple grid. Acid lime, magenta, teal, and orange accents tied to anatomy. The faction is feral mutated cave fauna: aggressive shapes and movement, expressive eyes, varied limbs and silhouettes.

Create a portrait 1024×1536 lineup for a mobile top-down survival game. Exactly 15 clearly separated cells, 3 columns by 5 rows, number 01 through 15 once each in reading order, no other text. One full-body subject per cell (08 is a single splitting enemy with two halves) and generous room around feet/tails/wings. Show from an elevated front 3/4 view, simple backing and contact shadows, distinct silhouettes with readable eyes, weight, bent joints, and motion. The faction is ALIVE: beasts and organic anatomy, faces and character, posed like they are about to attack. All features are physically attached to their bodies. No robots, buildings, boxes on legs, mobile towers, engines, wheeled machines, architecture, or gear-shaped bodies. No gore or body horror. Do not reference franchises. Leave clear breathing space even around the boss.

Row 1: 01 small snapping cave imp with long ears and splayed claws, low to the floor (basic); 02 lean running lizard with long bent hind legs and whip tail, in mid-bound (fast); 03 massive hunched purple ape with broad knuckles and feet digging in (heavy).
Row 2: 04 upright frilled spit-lizard with a short swollen throat and aiming posture (shooter); 05 tusked boar-like beast with head lowered and front claws spread, red crest sweeping backwards (charger); 06 orange puffer-toad with one huge luminous volatile belly, little braced feet (bomber).
Row 3: 07 gentle jade salamander with raised white cross-shaped dorsal marking and soft whiskers (repair); 08 two colorful conjoined slime heads pulling apart from one bright band of jelly, central seam clear (splitter); 09 wide magenta broodmother with two egg pouches built into its sides, crouched to release offspring (summoner).
Row 4: 10 thin insectoid marksman with a long straight needle-shaped proboscis and a steady aiming stance (sniper); 11 large blue frog with one wide upward-facing spore sac open on the back, legs braced (mortar); 12 floating violet bat with folded wings and a clearly visible face, twin pixel afterimage hints hugging its silhouette (teleporter).
Row 5: 13 a tall crest-lizard opening a fan of bright neck fins as a signal (buffer); 14 armadillo with a wide protective shield formed by folded forearm plates (armored); 15 giant horned cave salamander with four muscular legs, dominant face and orange pulsing stripe along spine, larger and more imposing (boss).

Subject family: inhabitants of a dangerous living swamp, with feathers, scales, moss, horns and amphibian skin. Almost folkloric menace, no human caricature.
